review_evidence: README identifies LeanML as a Mathlib-based formal verification project for machine-learning algorithms, with foundations, loss/optimization material, and verified linear-regression optimality results.
The 17 primary Lean files include 12 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across four proposition-bearing modules, alongside the definitions and interfaces those results depend on.

Direct inspection of Regression/Linear/Origin.lean shows formal definitions of Sxx, Sxy, least-squares loss and aStar together with proved nonnegativity, normal-equation, loss-decomposition, and global-minimization theorems; the test files exercise these formal interfaces and no lossless noise class was established.
summary: Retain LeanML as a substantive formalization of machine-learning definitions and verified regression results.
